articles.summary: Revenue of $729 million; pro forma revenue of $710 million; 7% pro forma revenue growth; 7% pro forma organic revenue growth GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $0.56; adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.38; GAAP pro forma EPS from continuing operations of $0.60; pro forma adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.37 Raises full year guidance Investor Day to be held November 13, 2026 Revvity, Inc. (NYSE: RVTY), today reported financial results for the third quarter ended October 4, 2026. The Company reported GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.56, as compared to $0.41 in the same period a year ago. Revenue for the quarter was $729 million, as compared to $699 million in the same period a year ago. GAAP operating income from continuing operations for the quarter was $95 million, as compared to $82 million for the same period a year ago.
